---
title: "Planted-truth recovery"
format: html
---

The planted effect is **0.5**. Across 400 simulations of
200 observations the mean estimate is **0.4924**
(bias -0.0076), and the interval covers the planted value in
**0.927** of runs.

| estimator | coverage |
|---|---|
| honest | 0.927 |
| shifted by 0.3 | 0.432 |
